import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# NEW-D: compute sequential tau statistics
df = pd.read_csv('/root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/exp009/bias_vs_rho.csv')

# Overall stats by method x rho
for method in ['sequential', 'joint']:
    for rho in sorted(df['rho'].unique()):
        sub = df[(df['method'] == method) & (df['rho'] == rho)]
        tau_mean = sub['kendall_tau'].mean()
        tau_std = sub['kendall_tau'].std()
        tau_median = sub['kendall_tau'].median()
        print(f'{method} rho={rho}: tau_mean={tau_mean:.4f} +/- {tau_std:.4f}, median={tau_median:.4f}, n={len(sub)}')

# Check if 0.859 appears anywhere
print()
print('Sequential tau closest to 0.859:')
seq = df[df['method'] == 'sequential']
seq_sorted = seq.iloc[(seq['kendall_tau'] - 0.859).abs().argsort()[:5]]
for _, r in seq_sorted.iterrows():
    print(f'  rho={r.rho}, seed={r.seed}: tau={r.kendall_tau:.6f}')

# Grand mean of sequential across all rhos
print(f'\nSequential grand mean tau (all rhos): {seq[\"kendall_tau\"].mean():.4f}')
print(f'Sequential mean tau (rho=0.0): {seq[seq[\"rho\"]==0.0][\"kendall_tau\"].mean():.4f}')
print(f'Sequential mean tau (rho=0.3): {seq[seq[\"rho\"]==0.3][\"kendall_tau\"].mean():.4f}')
print(f'Sequential mean tau (rho=0.6): {seq[seq[\"rho\"]==0.6][\"kendall_tau\"].mean():.4f}')
print(f'Sequential mean tau (rho=0.9): {seq[seq[\"rho\"]==0.9][\"kendall_tau\"].mean():.4f}')
"

from data_loader import load_data
import numpy as np
from collections import defaultdict

# Load data using the actual paths
data = load_data('/root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/exp001/results', '/root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/exp002/results/exposure_scores.csv')

print('\n=== NEW-A: Judge list ===')
print(f'Judge count: {data[\"J\"]}')
print(f'Judge list: {data[\"judge_names\"]}')

print('\n=== NEW-C: Crossing analysis ===')
print(f'N (models): {data[\"N\"]}')
print(f'I (items): {data[\"I\"]}')
print(f'J (judges): {data[\"J\"]}')
print(f'n_obs: {data[\"n_obs\"]}')
print(f'Full crossing: {data[\"N\"]} x {data[\"I\"]} x {data[\"J\"]} = {data[\"N\"] * data[\"I\"] * data[\"J\"]}')
print(f'Fill rate: {data[\"n_obs\"] / (data[\"N\"] * data[\"I\"] * data[\"J\"]):.1%}')

# Check per-judge coverage
model_idx = data['model_idx']
item_idx = data['item_idx']
judge_idx = data['judge_idx']

# Per-judge: how many (model, item) cells
for j, jname in enumerate(data['judge_names']):
    mask = judge_idx == j
    n = mask.sum()
    # unique model-item pairs
    mi_pairs = set(zip(model_idx[mask], item_idx[mask]))
    max_pairs = data['N'] * data['I']
    print(f'  {jname}: {n} obs, {len(mi_pairs)}/{max_pairs} cells filled ({len(mi_pairs)/max_pairs:.1%})')

# Check if each (model, item) has all 9 judges
from collections import Counter
mi_judge_count = defaultdict(set)
for m, i, j in zip(model_idx, item_idx, judge_idx):
    mi_judge_count[(m, i)].add(j)
counts = [len(v) for v in mi_judge_count.values()]
count_dist = Counter(counts)
print(f'\nJudge coverage per (model, item) cell:')
for k in sorted(count_dist.keys()):
    print(f'  {k} judges: {count_dist[k]} cells')
total_mi = len(mi_judge_count)
full_cells = count_dist.get(data['J'], 0)
print(f'Fully crossed cells: {full_cells}/{total_mi} ({full_cells/total_mi:.1%})')
"
